Game Information

Millionaire for Life™ is a daily draw game with a top prize of $1 MILLION a year FOR LIFE and a second prize of $100,000 a year FOR LIFE! There are 9 ways to win cash including the top prize. Each play costs $5. Drawings are held every day of the week after 10:15 p.m. CT. To be eligible on the nights of the drawings, you must purchase your Millionaire for Life™ tickets before 8:58 p.m. CT.

  • How to play: Select five white numbers 1 through 58 and one green number 1 through 5 - the Millionaire Ball™.
  • Cost per play: : $5
  • Top Prize: $1 MILLION a year FOR LIFE!
  • Overall Odds: 1:8.47
  • Draw days: Every night of the week
